description: Rolepod Codex hooks. Shared entries mirror root hooks/*.sh byte-exact (Codex uses the same event names, stdin JSON, and hookSpecificOutput/permissionDecision protocol as Claude — verified against the official hooks reference, 2026-08-05). Codex-only: agent-sync.sh (SessionStart → the Codex manifest has no agents component, so the plugin bundles agents/rolepod-*.toml + agents/AGENTS.rolepod.md and this hook copies them into ~/.codex/agents/ and refreshes ONLY the rolepod block of ~/.codex/AGENTS.md when the plugin version changes — `codex plugin marketplace upgrade` alone is then a complete update; ROLEPOD_AGENT_SYNC_OFF=1 disables). Codex now exposes SubagentStart/SubagentStop/Stop, so block-subagent-commit (deny) and session-lifecycle (cross-CLI sibling locks) are registered; still Claude-only: worktree-guard (apply_patch input shape has no file_path field). Hooks fire natively on Codex >=0.144, default-enabled via [features] hooks = true (the legacy plugin_hooks opt-in flag was removed upstream); plugin-bundled hooks must be trusted by the user before they run.
